channel.description: Latest articles from The Golf Channel (golfchannel.com)

item.title: Mi Hyang Lee leads after wild, windy third round at Blue Bay LPGA in China
item.description: Mi Hyang Lee made only five pars Saturday in a wild and windy round at the Blue Bay LPGA that ended with a 1-under 71, good enough to seize control with a three-shot lead as the South Korean goes after her first LPGA win more than eight years.

item.title: McIlroy withdraws from Round 3 of Arnold Palmer Invitational
item.description: Rory McIlroy withdrew Saturday before his third-round tee time at the 2026 Arnold Palmer Invitational. Todd Lewis reports on his "lower back" injury.

item.title: Spieth leads search party for his ball at Arnold Palmer Invitational
item.description: Jordan Spieth couldn't find his ball in the rough at the 12th hole Saturday at the Arnold Palmer Invitational and nearby fans helped him search for and eventually find it.

item.title: As he contends in PGA Tour debut, John Daly II has come a long way
item.description: Daly, the son of legendary pro John Daly, enters Sunday at the Puerto Rico Open three shots back, something he couldn't have done a couple years ago when he was a "bad driver of the golf ball" and battling his swing.

item.title: Ricky Castillo leads by one in Puerto Rico; Blades Brown, John Daly II chasing
item.description: Ricky Castillo posted a bogey-free round of 4-under 68 in strong wind Saturday to take a one-shot lead into the final round.

item.title: Rainmaker: Daniel Berger keeps the lead as softer greens take the teeth out of Bay Hill
item.description: Daniel Berger is 13-under par — even for the third round —with a two-shot lead was almost certain to grow when he returns for an eagle putt attempt Sunday morning. Akshay Bhatia was 11 under with a daunting 20-hole finish at Bay Hill on the horizon.

item.title: Bhatia builds momentum with late birdies at Bay Hill
item.description: Akshay Bhatia is closing in on the lead at Bay Hill Club and Lodge entering the final day of the Arnold Palmer Invitational. The 24-year-old Bhatia spoke to Golf Channel's Todd Lewis about his birdies on 15 and 16, and what he's doing to doing to prepare for 20 holes of golf Sunday.

item.title: Puerto Rico Open highlights: Brown, Daly II chasing Castillo
item.description: Blades Brown and John Daly II are among those chasing Ricky Castillo entering the final round of the 2026 Puerto Rico Open. Watch the best from Saturday's action!

item.title: Moving Day: Straka fires 66 to close in at Bay Hill
item.description: Sepp Straka shot 6-under 66 Saturday at Bay Hill to get closer to leader Daniel Berger in the 2026 Arnold Palmer Invitational. See how it did it in Golf Central's Penske Moving Day.

item.title: PGA Tour highlights 2026: Arnold Palmer Invitational, Round 3
item.description: Scottie Scheffler birdied five of six shots on his back nine at Bay Hill on Saturday but a slow start left the world's top-ranked player at even on the tournament through 54 holes. Viktor Hovland, Sepp Straka and Cameron Young enjoyed the best third rounds at the Arnold Palmer Invitational but Daniel Berger's lead remains unblemished as the four-time Tour winner seeks a wire-to-wire title.
